The AI Adoption Paradox

April 7, 2026 · Chris O'Hara

64%
of Americans now use AI tools monthly
Adoption has grown at twice the rate of smartphones in the late 2000s

The Verasight 2026 Predictions Report has a chart that tells the entire story of where enterprise AI sits right now.

The Paradox

64%

Use AI monthly

↑ Usage going up

42%

Express excitement

↓ Trust going flat

56% report anxiety about AI. More people used a chatbot last month than read a newspaper. The paradox is the chart: usage going up and to the right, trust going flat or down.

That's a single image that tells the entire story of where enterprise AI sits right now — and it's the exact setup for the Autonomous Enterprise's governance argument.

What This Means for PMMs

The Implication

The customers you're marketing to are already using AI but don't trust it. Governance and grounding aren't technical features — they're the emotional core of your positioning.

When 56% of your audience feels anxious about the technology they're already using, leading with "more AI features" misses the point. Lead with trust. Lead with control. Lead with governance.

This is why SAP's third differentiator — Enterprise-Grade Governance — should be a lead message at Sapphire, not a supporting point on the platform slide.

Source: Verasight 2026 Predictions Report
